The magic that flows through primal dragons can manifest more animalistic or bestial features in a given type of dragon. Notably among these are the massive paired horns of the horned dragon. While their bulky frames, natural coloration, and prominent ridged scales are all remarkable in their own way, it's the horns that are most obvious and striking at first glance. Horned dragons use their horns to impale their prey in a quick and brutal display of their might. They are generally contemplative and have a fixation on knowledge and self-discipline, traits belied by their bestial appearance. As a result, horned dragons are generally more open to speaking with outsiders. **[Recall Knowledge - Dragon](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35)): DC 38 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 36 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 33 [Ancient Horned Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2949) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 121 **Perception** +30; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet **Languages** [Chthonian](/Languages.aspx?ID=114), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Elven](/Languages.aspx?ID=4), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +25, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +32, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +30, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +27, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +31, [Forest Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +31, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +31, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +28, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +34, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) +31, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +29 **Str** +7 **Dex** +4 **Con** +5 **Int** +6 **Wis** +5 **Cha** +6 **Camouflage** The dragon can [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) in natural environments even if they don't have [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=459). --- **AC** 41 **Fort** +30 **Ref** +29 **Will** +32 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644) **HP** 315 **Immunities** [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) **[Frightful Presence](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=64)** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) 90 feet, DC 37
**Miasma** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669)) 20 feet. After the dragon uses their Poison Breath, a cloud of poison gas continues to emanate from their body for 1 round. Any creature that ends its turn in the miasma takes 4d6 poison damage (DC 37 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). Any creature in the miasma is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) and treats other creatures as concealed. The dragon can see through this concealment.
**Twisting Tail** **Trigger** A creature within reach of the dragon's tail uses a [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=658) action or leaves a square during a move action it's using; **Effect** The dragon makes a tail Strike at the creature with a –2 penalty. If the Strike hits, the dragon [disrupts](/Rules.aspx?ID=394) the creature's action. --- **Speed** 50 feet, fly 200 feet, swim 50 feet; forest passage, trackless journey **Melee** jaws +33 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d12+15 piercing plus 4d4 poison **Melee** claw +33 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+15 slashing **Melee** tail +31 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 25 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+13 bludgeoning **Melee** horn +31 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 2d10+13 piercing **Primal Innate Spells** DC 39 - **2nd** [Entangling Flora](/Spells.aspx?ID=1515) (at will) - **4th** [Charm](/Spells.aspx?ID=34) (at will), [Suggestion](/Spells.aspx?ID=315) - **6th** [Dominate](/Spells.aspx?ID=87) **Draconic Frenzy** The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horn Strike in any order. **Draconic Momentum** The dragon recharges their Poison Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike. **Forest Passage** The horned dragon ignores any [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) caused by plants, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth. Even plants manipulated by magic don't impede their progress. **Impaling Charge** **Requirements** The dragon doesn't have a creature impaled on their horn; **Effect** The dragon attempts to gore a foe. They Stride, then attempt a horn Strike. On a hit, the target becomes impaled on the dragon's horn. The creature is [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) while on the horn (and can attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) as normal). The dragon doesn't need to use additional actions to keep the impaled creature grabbed. If the dragon moves, they bring the grabbed creature along with them. **Poison Breath** ([Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134), [Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) The dragon breathes a toxic cloud that deals 18d6 poison damage in a 60-foot cone (DC 37 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). They can't use Poison Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Trackless Journey** The horned dragon always gains the benefits of [Cover Tracks](/Actions.aspx?ID=2407) in natural surroundings, even while moving at full speed.
